readout_preregistration.point: There is no training and no step axis. The read-out point is: all 134 items x 3 arms complete, with `n_scored == 134` ASSERTED per arm before any metric is computed. No metric may be computed on a partial arm.
readout_preregistration.why_an_assert_not_a_nan_check: A silent 5/8-shard merge once corrupted a whole protocol. The fix is asserting n_scored == expected per cell, not just checking for NaNs.
readout_preregistration.per_cell_reporting_rule: knowledge-update (n=78) and single-session-assistant (n=56) are reported SEPARATELY, always. The stratum-level n=134 number is reportable ONLY if the two per-type point estimates share the same sign. A02's -17.89pp pooled BABILong headline was a mean over 9 cells with OPPOSITE true signs (4 significantly negative, 2 significantly POSITIVE) -- 'pooling summarises nothing'.
readout_preregistration.statistics: Paired bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, seed 42. MUST run on ONE node: the five nodes carry three numpy versions (LOCAL 2.3.5 / .82 2.4.6 / rest 2.5.1) and same-seed multinomial differs, so cross-node resampling is not reproducible.
readout_preregistration.abstention_handling: 30 `_abs` items exist repo-wide; 6 of them are inside knowledge-update, 0 in single-session-assistant. They are scored by the abstention rule (correct iff the model refuses), never by substring/F1. Primary denominator is therefore 128 = 134 - 6. Mis-scoring these corrupts both ACC and U.

kill_gate.source: PROPOSAL.md 'Kill 条件' clause 1 ('notes-only 幻觉率高且 notes+raw 不优于 raw'), made arithmetic. Full derivation in B08_LEG1_GATE_PREREG.md section 5.
kill_gate.definitions: All paired, all in absolute pp, on the retrieval-closed stratum. Delta_aug = ACC(A-notes+raw) - ACC(A-raw). Delta_sub = ACC(A-notes-only) - ACC(A-raw). Delta_U = U(A-notes-only) - U(A-raw). ACC = judge-correct rate via scripts/a02_judge_openweight.py. U = unsupported-claim rate = fraction of non-abstention answers containing a factual claim absent from THAT ARM'S OWN context.
conditions_KILL_iff_ALL_THREE: K1: Delta_aug 95% paired-bootstrap CI CONTAINS 0 -> adding notes to raw buys nothing this design can resolve (< 10.82 pp).

K2: Delta_U 95% CI UPPER BOUND < +5.0 pp -> notes-only does NOT hallucinate measurably more, so the proposal's faithfulness invariant has nothing to measure. ** SUBJECT TO k2_evaluability_precondition below: at n=134 this clause is only reachable if disc_U <= 0.0872, else the ALL-THREE KILL branch is unreachable and the stratum MUST be extended to n=500. **
K3: Delta_sub 95% CI is NOT entirely above -2.0 pp -> notes-only is not near-parity either, so there is no compression story.
kill_gate.kill_meaning: All three ==> notes merely OMIT facts without inventing them, and adding them changes nothing resolvable. There is no paper in that. Archive leg 1.
kill_gate.threshold_derivation: 10.82 pp is not a round number: it is the MDE for a paired binary comparison at 80% power, two-sided alpha=0.05, computed as (z_0.975 + z_0.80) * sqrt(disc/n) * 100 = (1.95996+0.84162)*sqrt(0.20/134)*100 = 10.82 pp at n=134, disc=0.20. Measured grid: n=78 -> 10.03/14.19/17.37 pp at disc=0.10/0.20/0.30; n=134 -> 7.65/10.82/13.26; n=500 -> 3.96/5.60/6.86. This is WHY the primary cell is the n=134 stratum and not knowledge-update alone: n=78 cannot resolve anything under ~14pp. The observed discordance will be reported and the MDE recomputed from it; the FORMULA is what is pre-registered.
kill_gate.portfolio_level_rule: B08 is ARCHIVED as a portfolio iff this gate kills, in the same run. Leg 1 dies directly. Leg 2 dies because its entire task surface (overwrite / stale / contradiction / supersession) IS the knowledge-update cell -- if context composition moves neither ACC nor U on the cell where facts are superseded BY CONSTRUCTION, then a typed ledger, whose only lever is MARKING that supersession in the context, has no surface left; its own clause ('typed ledger does not reduce stale/conflict error') is evaluated on that same n=78. Leg 3 is already deprioritised on A02's measured 1.03-1.37x fixed-Read advantage and N* = 8 -> 25 -> 186 scaling, and nothing in this run resurrects it. So ONE ~1.1 GPU-h experiment can kill B08 outright: it is no longer unkillable.
kill_gate.falsifiability_worked_example: Plausible KILL: ACC A-raw 61.9% / A-notes+raw 64.9% / A-notes-only 53.7%; U A-raw 8.2% / A-notes-only 8.9%. Then Delta_aug=+3.0pp CI[-4.5,+10.4] contains 0 (K1 fires); Delta_U=+0.7pp CI[-2.6,+4.1] UB<5.0 (K2 fires); Delta_sub=-8.2pp CI[-15.1,-1.8] not entirely >-2.0 (K3 fires) => KILL. Plausible PASS: Delta_aug=+12.0pp CI[+3.1,+20.6] (K1 does not fire), or Delta_U=+11.4pp CI[+6.2,+16.9] (K2 does not fire). The gate is two-sided.
kill_gate.denominator_guard: All primary read-outs are ABSOLUTE pp differences, so no denominator exists and none is needed. IF anyone later reports a 'fraction of headroom recovered', the denominator is (ceiling - ACC(A-raw)) with ceiling = 100% (justified: measured any_hit = 1.000 on this stratum). That ratio is FORBIDDEN unless ACC(A-raw) <= 95.0%, i.e. denominator >= 5.0 pp, and the guard must be committed BEFORE scoring. Rationale: as the denominator -> 0 the ratio explodes and flips sign on noise; a range is not a measurement until it clears its floor.
kill_gate.protocol_invariant_preserved: PROPOSAL.md's '必须测 notes faithfulness, 不能让 summary 成为唯一事实源' is now a FIRST-CLASS pre-registered read-out (the U metric on A-notes-only), not an afterthought. It was previously unimplementable: no faithfulness scorer exists anywhere in the tree.

k2_evaluability_precondition_ADDED_20260.defect: K2 as originally written fires iff the Delta_U 95% CI UPPER BOUND < +5.0 pp. At n=134 the paired half-width is 1.96*sqrt(disc_U/134). Even at a TRUE Delta_U of exactly 0, that UB lands below +5.0 pp ONLY IF disc_U <= 0.0872. For any unsupported-claim discordance above 8.72% -- entirely plausible for a hallucination metric on a base model -- K2 can NEVER fire, so the ALL-THREE KILL branch is UNREACHABLE and the gate degenerates into one that can only pass or abstain. That is not a gate.
k2_evaluability_precondition_ADDED_20260.precondition: BEFORE any Delta is inspected, compute disc_U = observed unsupported-claim discordance between A-notes-only and A-raw. IF disc_U <= 0.0872, n=134 can resolve K2 and the gate is read out at n=134. IF disc_U > 0.0872, n=134 CANNOT resolve K2 and the stratum is MANDATORILY extended to the full n=500 (same three arms, same frozen retrieval, measured 4.31 GPU-h), which holds the half-width at 3.92 pp even at disc_U=0.20.
k2_evaluability_precondition_ADDED_20260.why_this_is_not_an_n_hack: The escalation decision is a function of disc_U ALONE -- a dispersion quantity -- and is taken BEFORE Delta_aug's or Delta_U's sign is looked at. It is pre-committed here, PRE-DATA. Escalation is MANDATORY when triggered, not optional, so it cannot be used to shop for a result.

gpu_cost_estimate.node_requirement: sm_90 (.73 / .82 / .104) REQUIRED, not merely preferred. Reasons: (1) the j0_top12 s/token anchor was measured on .82 = H20 = sm_90, so running on sm_100 would make the 1.15 GPU-h figure a cross-architecture extrapolation rather than a validated one -- and the same-arch rule exists precisely so a cost claim is not confounded with hardware drift; (2) the open-weight Qwen3-8B judge protocol was established on .82, and the judge is scored cross-arm here; (3) all 3 arms MUST run sequentially in one process on ONE card, which is also what makes within-run comparability hold by construction. NOT an sm_100 task: nothing needs B200's 178 GB or Blackwell -- an 8B bf16 model with a 4.6k-token max prompt fits in well under 40 GB. This is a FIRST run, so there is no archived B08 quality result that a new number must be same-arch comparable to; the arch constraint here is about the COST anchor and the judge, not about a quality baseline.

blocker_disposition_20260815.NEW_BLOCKER_8_judge_adapter_is_a_field_l: a02_judge_openweight.py:187-201 load_preds() globs preds*.jsonl per --result_dirs entry and keys on item['id'] (hard KeyError if absent), then reads item['pred'] (:341,357), item['question'] (:355), item.get('answers',[]) (:356), item.get('category') (:354) and item.get('is_abstention',False) (:337). But write_submission (scoring.py:30-43) emits ONLY question_id + hypothesis into a SINGLE file and DISCARDS the gold answer, the question text, the question type and any abstention marker. So the adapter must RE-JOIN the submission against the source data to recover four fields, not rename two. TWO PRE-COMMITMENTS: (a) is_abstention MUST be set explicitly -- if it defaults False the 6 _abs items go to the semantic judge instead of the refusal rule (:337-340), which abstention_handling says corrupts BOTH ACC and U; they are identifiable by the _abs question_id suffix, and note they DO carry a gold answer string plus 2 gold sessions each, so a naive 'no gold answer => abstention' heuristic would NOT find them. (b) EACH ARM NEEDS ITS OWN RESULT DIRECTORY: the judge writes judge_meta.json per dir (:291-293) and appends to judge_cache_openweight.jsonl (:296,346) keyed on 'id' ALONE with NO arm field, so a shared directory would make arm 2 silently reuse arm 1's verdicts -- a same-id-different-pred collision that raises no error and produces no NaN. THIS IS THE MOST DANGEROUS ITEM FOUND THIS SESSION. Also: the judge's _JUDGE_TEMPLATE (:48-63) names LoCoMo explicitly; recommendation is to KEEP IT VERBATIM (protocol identity beats the benchmark noun, and B08 has no archived judge numbers to be consistent with) and RECORD the choice in judge_meta.json PRE-DATA.

ready_queue_visibility_defect_20260815.why_this_matters: The scheduler has never known that B08 has unmet prerequisites. It classifies B08 ready_cpu purely because novelty_checked is false ('novelty gate not adjudicated (absent) -> the actionable task is 0 GPU: run it'). That reason is now WRONG IN ITS PARTICULARS -- the adjudication was done and committed (463dca4) and re-verified here -- yet it lands on the right ANSWER (ready_cpu, not ready_gpu) for the wrong reason. If anyone later flips novelty_checked to true, B08 would jump toward ready_gpu with FIVE open CPU blockers (3, 5, 7, 8, 9) that the reader cannot see. That is the paperwork-counts-as-readiness failure ready_queue.py was written to prevent, arriving through a key-name gap instead of a logic gap.
ready_queue_visibility_defect_20260815.second_defect_declared_lifecycle_is_igno: STATUS.json declares lifecycle 'needs_prior_gate'. ready_queue.py REPORTS ready_cpu. Only dead / promoted / running / ready_cpu short-circuit as authoritative in the explicit-lifecycle block; 'needs_prior_gate' falls through to inference, which overrides it. BENIGN for GPU safety today (both values are != ready_gpu, so no card can be mis-dispatched) but it is a declared-vs-inferred mismatch on the field LIFECYCLE_SCHEMA.md calls '唯一的机器可读状态', and it is the same class of bug as the two under-reads ready_queue.py already documents fixing at :30-70.
ready_queue_visibility_defect_20260815.recommended_fix_NOT_APPLIED: Add 'remaining_blockers_all_CPU' and 'prior_gate' to BLOCK_KEYS, and let 'needs_prior_gate' short-circuit as authoritative like the other terminal and holding states. DELIBERATELY NOT DONE HERE: ready_queue.py is the shared scheduler read by every proposal, so changing BLOCK_KEYS would re-classify all 15 STATUS.json files at once -- that needs its own before/after diff across the whole queue, not a drive-by edit inside a B08 task. Per memory/fix-the-class-not-the-instance.md the right move is to fix the KEY FAMILY for every proposal in one reviewed change, and per memory/reporting-a-gap-is-not-closing-it.md this is filed as an explicit task rather than a caveat. Whoever takes it must diff `python3 proposal/ready_queue.py` before and after and confirm no proposal moves INTO ready_gpu.
